horizon_selection.rule: select the first candidate whose gain over the final 500 updates is at most 0.05 dB; use 20000 if neither earlier candidate passes

gaussianimage.optimizer: Adam with native exponential learning-rate schedule

structsplat_mask_contained.attempted_step_accounting: topology recovery and checkpoint work is recorded separately and can raise actual attempted updates above the nominal phase sum
structsplat_mask_contained.pixel_loss: masked L2 plus phase-specific boundary undercoverage

structsplat_no_boundary.attempted_step_accounting: topology recovery and checkpoint work is recorded separately and can raise actual attempted updates above the nominal phase sum

classification: production conversion and diagnostic comparison; not claim-ready evidence

outputs.qa: native-resolution fit-window reconstruction JPEG and full-canvas JPEG
outputs.verification: strict CompactView/CompactDataset reload, source hashes, count/cap, provider semantics, and exact-zero-outside check for the contained arm

preprocessing.fit_window: tight foreground crop plus the realtime-gs 5% margin

shared_budget.seed_rule: seed_base plus lexicographically sorted view index
